key_idea: A colour is a valid L-triomino iff it occupies exactly 3 cells whose bounding box is 2x2.
sketch: Read the grid, and per colour track cell count and min/max row and column. Answer 1 iff the value 0 appears exactly once and every colour 1..(4^n-1)/3 appears exactly 3 times with bounding box exactly 2x2 (3 cells in a 2x2 box is always an L). O(4^n) time and memory, about 1M cells. Pitfalls: colours that never appear (count 0) must fail, and a straight line of 3 has a 1x3 box so it is rejected.
